ops.title: Timezone Board: way to a demo-ready product understanding
ops.body:
## Destination

A shared product understanding of the Timezone Board (audience, five Zones, Glance view behavior, stack constraints) plus at least one UI prototype the owner has reacted to, clear enough that `/to-spec` and `/to-tickets` can run without open product fog. Implementation is out of scope on this map.

## Notes

- Domain: Timezone Board demo for a colleague. Glossary: root `CONTEXT.md`.
- Skills every session should consult: `/grilling`, `/domain-modeling`; for the prototype ticket, `/prototype`.
- Standing preference: this is a demonstration project. Prefer the agent's recommended answer on every grilling ticket and record that recommendation as the decision unless a human overrides it.
- Framing already accepted while charting: personal utility only (no accounts, no sharing); five fixed Zones; single Glance view page.
- Recommended defaults to propose when resolving tickets (not yet decided until their tickets close):
  - Zones: London, New York, Los Angeles, Tokyo, Sydney.
  - Glance view: city label, large local time, weekday/date, UTC offset; live tick every second.
  - Stack: Vite static site (vanilla TypeScript), static hosting.
  - Visual: light cool slate, strong typography, full-bleed atmospheric background; avoid purple-on-white, cream-and-terracotta, and default dark-mode looks.

## Decisions so far

<!-- the index — one line per closed ticket -->

## Not yet specified

- Exact responsive layout breakpoints and mobile composition after the first prototype reaction.
- Accessibility and reduced-motion expectations once the visual direction is locked.
- Copy tone for Zone labels (city only vs city + region).
- Whether the live tick should pause when the tab is hidden (battery/perf detail).

## Out of scope

- Building or deploying the production site (starts after `/to-spec` and `/to-tickets`).
- User accounts, auth, multi-user boards, or per-visitor configurable Zones.
- Native apps, notifications, or timezone conversion calculators.
- Adding more or fewer than five Zones in this effort.
